o1: Enables DEAD/H-box RNA helicase binding activity; enables protein phosphatase regulator activity; predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity; and contributes to protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in embryo development; sarcomere organization; axon guidance; centriole replication; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and cellular response to UV. Is located in P granule; microtubule cytoskeleton; nuclear envelope; and the I band. Is part of protein phosphatase type 2A complex. Is expressed in excretory cell; hypodermis; nervous system (including neurons); non-striated muscle; body-wall muscle; and reproductive system. Is part of centriole assembly pathway. Predicted to interact with let-92 and sur-6. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 36 and lung cancer. Orthologous to human PPP2R1A (protein phosphatase 2 scaffold subunit Aalpha) and PPP2R1B (protein phosphatase 2 scaffold subunit Abeta).
